verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer building blocks for constructing agents: the Agents SDK, a managed Codex harness for building agents, and built-in tools callable via the API. It does not show a built-in assistant inside the platform or dashboard to which a user can delegate tasks. Primitives for building an assistant are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
